newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare wins appeal of judgement.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare wins appeal of judgement.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit reversed a $2.7 million judgement against the company.
The judgement had been the result of an action filed in 1992 by Comprehensive Care Corp, RehabCare's former parent.
Comprehensive Care had alleged breach of contract and fraud by RehabCare in connection with a redemption by RehabCare of shares of RehabCare common then-owned by Comprehensive Care.
It said the court ruled unanimously that RehabCare did nothing to deprive Comprehensive Care of its expected contractual benefits in connection with the redemption.

RehabCare said the court also ruled the Comprehensive Care knew all material facts related to the redemption transaction through information RehabCare had given to Comprehensive Care's two representatives on RehabCare's board of directors before the agreement was executed.
